data.name: UNDO
data.description: UNDO Carbon Ltd. is a UK-based CO2 removal company specializing in enhanced rock weathering. UNDO has spread more than 313,800 tonnes of silicate rock across 398 farms, enriching 54,400 acres of agricultural land and setting up the permanent removal of roughly 69,000 tonnes of CO2, and in 2025 was named one of four global winners of the US$100 million XPRIZE Carbon Removal competition. In November 2025 UNDO signed an exclusive partnership with Verde AgriTech to scale ERW in Brazil.
